description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters class, a plugin for the Ext JS library (version 3.3.0). It provides advanced filtering capabilities for grid components, including UI for configuring filters, automatic state persistence, integration with paging tools, and support for various filter types such as string, numeric, date, list, and boolean. The class offers methods for managing filters, building filter queries, and handling filter state changes, enabling developers to add complex column filtering features to Ext JS grids.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters
classes.description: A plugin for Ext JS 3.3.0 grids that adds advanced filtering capabilities, including customizable filter types, UI integration, state persistence, and compatibility with paging toolbar. It manages a collection of filters, handles UI menu interactions, and provides query-building methods for server communication.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GridFilters plugin with configuration, setting up filter collection and event handlers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Binds the plugin to a grid or paging toolbar, setting up necessary event listeners and UI components.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Restores filter states from saved configuration during grid or component reinitialization.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes the current active filters into the grid's state object for persistence.

methods.name: onRender
methods.description: Sets up UI elements like the filter menu when the grid is rendered.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and UI components when the plugin or grid is destroyed.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all filters from the collection, destroying filter instances.

methods.name: bindStore
methods.description: Attaches the plugin to a data store, setting up load or beforeload event handlers based on filter mode.

methods.name: onReconfigure
methods.description: Handles grid reconfiguration; rebinds the store, clears, and re-initializes filters.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Generates the filter menu UI in the grid header.

methods.name: getMenuFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the filter associated with the clicked header menu.

methods.name: onMenu
methods.description: Prepares the filter submenu for display before it appears.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a filter based on menu checkbox.

methods.name: onBeforeCheck
methods.description: Prevents deactivation of a filter if it is not activatable.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in filter state; triggers UI updates and optional reloads.

methods.name: onBeforeLoad
methods.description: Adds filter parameters to the store's request before loading data for remote filtering.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Applies active filters locally after store load when local filtering is enabled.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Updates filter header styles after grid view refresh.

methods.name: updateColumnHeadings
methods.description: Updates header cell classes to reflect active filters.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Triggers data reload or local filtering based on current filter configurations.

methods.name: getRecordFilter
methods.description: Returns a function to filter records based on active filters.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a single filter object to the collection and wires its events.

methods.name: addFilters
methods.description: Adds multiple filters from configuration or column model.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter by its data index.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Deactivates all active filters without removing their configurations.

methods.name: getFilterData
methods.description: Returns an array of data objects representing current active filters.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Builds a filter query object (string or JSON) for server requests based on active filters.

methods.name: cleanParams
methods.description: Removes filter-related parameters from a request parameter object.

methods.name: getFilterClass
methods.description: Returns the filter class for a given filter type, allowing dynamic filter class loading.
